evals.prompt: Sense-check the upcoming release of a new Steam game using only public online data. Give me the full report and an upfront-buy posture for game keys.
evals.expected_output: Uses the complete report template, separates demand from purchase intent and risk, cites public sources, and avoids inventing exact reseller sales.

evals.prompt: Research the last 30 days of discussion around a newly launched game and tell me whether the hype is converting into launch-buy intent or mostly sale-wait interest.
evals.expected_output: Runs recent community research, performs aspect-based sentiment and purchase-intent analysis, reports the hype-to-intent gap, and includes source coverage.

evals.prompt: Compare three upcoming Steam releases and rank them for a controlled initial key purchase. I have no internal sales data.
evals.expected_output: Uses comparable public evidence, confidence-aware scoring, markdown risk, and a ranked buy posture without pretending to know the user's channel share.
